b1-25-01.title: Communicative Challenge: A Changing City
b1-25-01.scenario: Károly asks Meg how the city has changed in recent years. You (Meg) say that the city has become much more beautiful and that a lot of change has happened.
b1-25-01.prompt: Tell Károly what has happened to the city.
cues: Say that the city has become more beautiful
Say that a lot has changed
b1-25-01.target: A város az utóbbi években nagyon szépült. Sok változás történt.
b1-25-01.english: The city has become much more beautiful in recent years. A lot of change has happened.
b1-25-01.canDo: I can say that something changes or becomes something, with -vá/-vé and verbs such as szépül.

b1-25-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Learning Step by Step
b1-25-02.scenario: Petra asks Meg how she is learning Hungarian. You (Meg) say that you are not in a hurry and that you learn gradually, step by step.
b1-25-02.prompt: Tell Petra how you are learning Hungarian.
cues: Say that you are not in a hurry
Say how you learn: gradually and step by step
b1-25-02.target: Nem sietek, fokozatosan tanulok magyarul. Lépésről lépésre haladok.
b1-25-02.english: I'm not in a hurry; I learn Hungarian gradually. I make progress step by step.
b1-25-02.canDo: I can say that something happens gradually, with fokozatosan and lépésről lépésre.

b1-25-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Then and Now
b1-25-03.scenario: Károly asks Meg whether many people learn Hungarian. You (Meg) say that in the past few people did, but that today many people do.
b1-25-03.prompt: Tell Károly how the past and the present differ.
cues: Say what the past was like
Contrast it with today
b1-25-03.target: Míg régen kevés ember tanult magyarul, ma viszont sok ember tanul.
b1-25-03.english: While in the past few people learned Hungarian, today many people do.
b1-25-03.canDo: I can contrast the past with the present with míg régen … ma viszont ….

b1-25-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A New Situation
b1-25-04.scenario: Károly asks Meg how she is coping with the big changes lately. You (Meg) say that you adapted quickly to the new situation and that you reassessed your goals.
b1-25-04.prompt: Tell Károly how you coped with the changes.
cues: Say that you adapted quickly to the new situation
Say what you reassessed
b1-25-04.target: Gyorsan alkalmazkodtam az új helyzethez. Átértékeltem a céljaimat.
b1-25-04.english: I adapted quickly to the new situation. I reassessed my goals.
b1-25-04.canDo: I can say that I adapt to a new situation, with alkalmazkodik and -hoz/-hez.

b1-25-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Internet as a Milestone
b1-25-05.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the spread of the internet meant for people. You (Meg) say that it counted as an important milestone and that it marked a new era.
b1-25-05.prompt: Tell Petra what the spread of the internet meant.
cues: Say that it counted as an important milestone
Say that it marked a new era
b1-25-05.target: Az internet elterjedése fontos mérföldkőnek számított. Korszakváltást jelentett.
b1-25-05.english: The spread of the internet counted as an important milestone. It marked an epochal shift.
b1-25-05.canDo: I can say that something counts as a milestone, with mérföldkőnek számít.

b1-25-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Misi and the Teachers
b1-25-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the story about Nyilas Misi is about. You (Meg) say that Misi tells the teachers that he took nothing, and that after the hard days the realisation ripened in him.
b1-25-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra what Misi says and what happens in him.
cues: Say what Misi tells the teachers
Say what ripened in him after the hard days
b1-25-consolidation.target: Misi azt mondja, hogy nem vett el semmit. A nehéz napok után megérett benne a felismerés.
b1-25-consolidation.english: Misi says that he took nothing. After the hard days the realisation ripened in him.
b1-25-consolidation.canDo: I can retell a short story about a pupil who is wrongly accused and grows up, in a few sentences.

b1-26-01.title: Communicative Challenge: A Calling
b1-26-01.scenario: Petra asks Meg what she thinks about the work of a doctor. You (Meg) say that a good doctor considers the work a calling and that a doctor is well-versed in the profession.
b1-26-01.prompt: Tell Petra how a good doctor sees the work and what the doctor knows well.
cues: Say how a good doctor sees the work
Say that the doctor is well-versed in the profession
b1-26-01.target: A jó orvos hivatásának tekinti a munkáját. Jártas a szakmában.
b1-26-01.english: A good doctor considers his work his calling. He is well-versed in the profession.
b1-26-01.canDo: I can say that I consider my work a calling, with hivatásának tekinti.

b1-26-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Too Much Overtime
b1-26-02.scenario: Károly says that he has worked a lot of overtime lately and feels tired. You (Meg) say that he must not overdo work and that he has to set aside time for rest.
b1-26-02.prompt: Tell Károly what he must not do and what he has to make time for.
cues: Say that he must not overdo work
Say that he has to set aside time for rest
b1-26-02.target: Nem szabad túlzásba vinned a munkát. Időt kell szánnod a pihenésre.
b1-26-02.english: You must not overdo work. You have to set aside time for rest.
b1-26-02.canDo: I can say that I must not overdo work and that I set aside time for rest, with túlzásba visz and időt szán.

b1-26-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Work and Family
b1-26-03.scenario: Károly asks Meg how she manages her work and her family. You (Meg) say that you create a balance between work and family and that urgent work takes priority.
b1-26-03.prompt: Tell Károly how you manage work and family.
cues: Say that you create balance between work and family
Say what takes priority
b1-26-03.target: Megteremtem az egyensúlyt a munka és a család között. A sürgős munka prioritást élvez.
b1-26-03.english: I create a balance between work and family. Urgent work takes priority.
b1-26-03.canDo: I can say that I create balance between work and family, with megteremti az egyensúlyt.

b1-26-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Recognition at Work
b1-26-04.scenario: Petra asks Meg what happened to a colleague at the end of the year. You (Meg) say that the colleague strives for promotion and that the team received recognition.
b1-26-04.prompt: Tell Petra what your colleague wants and what the team got.
cues: Say what your colleague strives for
Say what the team received
b1-26-04.target: A kollégám az előléptetésre törekszik. A csapat elismerésben részesült.
b1-26-04.english: My colleague is striving for promotion. The team received recognition.
b1-26-04.canDo: I can say that I strive for promotion and receive recognition, with törekszik and elismerésben részesül.

b1-26-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Good Atmosphere
b1-26-05.scenario: Károly asks Meg why she likes her workplace. You (Meg) say that you find joy in your work and that a pleasant atmosphere matters to everyone.
b1-26-05.prompt: Tell Károly why you like your workplace.
cues: Say that you find joy in your work
Say what is important for everyone
b1-26-05.target: Örömömet lelem a munkámban. A kellemes munkahelyi légkör mindenkinek fontos.
b1-26-05.english: I find joy in my work. A pleasant workplace atmosphere is important for everyone.
b1-26-05.canDo: I can say that I find joy in my work and stay faithful to my values, with örömét leli and hű marad.

b1-26-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Édes Anna
b1-26-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the story about Édes Anna is about. You (Meg) say that Vizyné shows her flat to her guests and that Moviszter doktor says that a person is not a machine.
b1-26-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra what Vizyné does and what Moviszter doktor says.
cues: Say what Vizyné shows her guests
Say what the doctor says about people
b1-26-consolidation.target: Vizyné a vendégeinek mutatja a lakását. Moviszter doktor azt mondja, hogy az ember nem gép.
b1-26-consolidation.english: Vizyné shows her flat to her guests. Doktor Moviszter says that a person is not a machine.
b1-26-consolidation.canDo: I can retell a short story about a maid and her employers in a few sentences.

b1-27-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Anna's Party
b1-27-01.scenario: Petra asks Meg how Anna's party went. You (Meg) say that Anna said she felt very good at the party and that the hosts were very kind.
b1-27-01.prompt: Tell Petra what Anna said about the party and what the hosts were like.
cues: Say what Anna said about how she felt
Say what the hosts were like
b1-27-01.target: Anna azt mondta, hogy nagyon jól érezte magát a bulin. A házigazdák nagyon kedvesek voltak.
b1-27-01.english: Anna said that she felt very good at the party. The hosts were very kind.
b1-27-01.canDo: I can report what someone said, with azt mondta, hogy ….

b1-27-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Question from a Colleague
b1-27-02.scenario: Petra asks Meg what her colleague wanted. You (Meg) say that the colleague asked whether you are going to the meeting.
b1-27-02.prompt: Tell Petra what your colleague asked.
cues: Say who asked
Say what the colleague asked about the meeting
b1-27-02.target: A kollégám azt kérdezte, hogy elmegyek-e a megbeszélésre.
b1-27-02.english: My colleague asked whether I am going to the meeting.
b1-27-02.canDo: I can report a question, with azt kérdezte, hogy … -e.

b1-27-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Keeping a Secret
b1-27-03.scenario: Károly asks Meg what she told Anna about the secret. You (Meg) say that you asked Anna not to tell anyone the secret.
b1-27-03.prompt: Tell Károly what you asked Anna to do.
cues: Say that you asked Anna
Say what she must not tell anyone
b1-27-03.target: Arra kértem Annát, hogy ne mondja el senkinek a titkot.
b1-27-03.english: I asked Anna not to tell anyone the secret.
b1-27-03.canDo: I can report a request or a command, with arra kért, hogy … + subjunctive.

b1-27-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Good Friends
b1-27-04.scenario: Petra asks Meg what makes a good friendship. You (Meg) say that good friends stand up for each other and stay faithful to each other.
b1-27-04.prompt: Tell Petra what good friends do for each other.
cues: Say that good friends stand up for each other
Say that they stay faithful to each other
b1-27-04.target: A jó barátok kiállnak egymásért. Hűek maradnak egymáshoz.
b1-27-04.english: Good friends stand up for each other. They stay faithful to each other.
b1-27-04.canDo: I can say that people do something for each other, with egymás in its case forms.

b1-27-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Going Anyway
b1-27-05.scenario: Károly asks Meg why she went to the meeting yesterday. You (Meg) say that although you were tired, you went to the meeting anyway.
b1-27-05.prompt: Tell Károly what you did in spite of being tired.
cues: Say that you were tired
Say that you went to the meeting anyway
b1-27-05.target: Bár fáradt voltam, mégis elmentem a találkozóra.
b1-27-05.english: Although I was tired, I went to the meeting anyway.
b1-27-05.canDo: I can say that something happened in spite of an obstacle, with bár, noha and annak ellenére, hogy.

b1-27-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Nemecsek and Áts Feri
b1-27-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg what Nemecsek said to Áts Feri in the story. You (Meg) say that Nemecsek said he stays with his friends and does not go away.
b1-27-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra what Nemecsek said to Áts Feri.
cues: Say what Nemecsek told Áts Feri
Say that he does not go away
b1-27-consolidation.target: Nemecsek azt mondta Áts Ferinek, hogy a barátaival marad. Nem megy el.
b1-27-consolidation.english: Nemecsek told Áts Feri that he stays with his friends. He does not go away.
b1-27-consolidation.canDo: I can retell a short story about a boy who stays faithful to his friends, in a few sentences.
